p=""; [ -t 0 ] || p="$(cat 2>/dev/null || true)"; c="$(printf '%s' "$p" | python3 -c 'import json,sys;d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read() or "{}");ti=d.get("tool_input") or {};sys.stdout.write(str(ti.get("command") or ""))' 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$c" ] || c="$p"; [ -n "$c" ] || c="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}"; printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'rm -rf|git reset --hard|git push .*--force' && { echo 'BLOCKED: destructive command — enumerate exact resolved paths/refs and get explicit user confirmation first' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ -f mix.exs ] || exit 0; out=$(mix compile --warnings-as-errors 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: mix compile --warnings-as-errors is failing — fix it or explain why before stopping (run the 'gate' skill for the full protocol):" >&2; echo "$out" | tail -40 >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
